title: asghar haaye asghar
body:
asghar haaye asghar
ay mere asghare bezabaan
tujhe dhundne jaawun kahaan
<<MINI>>
asghar haaye asghar asghar haaye asghar
ay che mahine waale tujhko mera salaam
asghar haaye asghar asghar haaye asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shaahedeen ke dilbar
ay ruhe qalbe maadar
ay tashnakaam asghar
ay bezabaan asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
shikwa na karna asghar
paani nahi mayassar
aansu bahake maine
turbat ko kar diya tar
<<DIVIDER>>
tashnaalabi pe teri
giryaan hai ye khudaayi
mazlumiyat ne teri
insaaniyat jagaayi
<<DIVIDER>>
baanu bhi ro rahi hai
kis darja bekasi hai
asghar teri lahad par
khud maut keh rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
pucho ali ziya se
irfan karbala se
baanu ke dil ko denge
ye lafz hi dilaase
<<DIVIDER>>
taarikhe karbala ko
parh kar anees dekho
dushman bhi sar jhukaaye
kehte milenge tumko
<<MINI>>
ay che mahine waale tujhko mera salaam
asghar haaye asghar asghar haaye asghar
